messages:
incident-bot: Paging: high error rate (5xx) on prod edge gateway across us-west-2. Alerting threshold breached: 12m sustained. See alert: https://ops/redwood/alerts/1969876543 :rotating_light:
Alex: I'm on it — seeing 502/525s from the gateway logs, lots of TLS handshake errors. Can someone confirm which cert bundle was last rotated?
Maria: hitting the same. tail from edge-proxy: 
```
 2026-03-14T10:12:01Z proxy-1 nginx[1234]: 502 upstream connect error or disconnect while reading upstream, client: 10.2.3.4, server: gateway, request: "POST /v1/generate"
 2026-03-14T10:12:02Z proxy-1 kernel: TLS alert number 40 while establishing TLS connection from 10.2.3.5: handshake failure
```
Devon: I see lots of `SSL routines:ssl3_get_client_hello:no shared cipher` in client logs. Could be cert/key mismatch or CA change.
Priya: @Alex any recent CA/intermediate rotation? We did a NAMED intermediate rotate two days ago for staging but not prod.
Alex: Not in prod. I'm pulling the cert chain from the load balancer.
Alex: `openssl s_client -connect gateway.prod.redwood.ai:443 -showcerts -servername api.redwood.ai` output shows the intermediate cert expired: 
```
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=gateway.prod.redwood.ai
 1 s:/CN=Redwood Legacy Intermediate
    i:/CN=Redwood Root CA

subject=/CN=Redwood Legacy Intermediate
issuer=/CN=Redwood Root CA
notAfter=Mar 12 09:00:00 2026 GMT (INVALID)
```
Maria: whoa that intermediate expired yesterday? but we rolled a new one for dedicated last week. Looks like prod LB still serving old chain.
Samir: Confirming from LB config: the cert file `prod_chain.pem` on lb-west-1 is the old bundle. Owner tag says `manual-update/legacy`.
Devon: Any chance OCSP stapling is failing and clients are treating as hard fail? Logs show `certificate verify failed: certificate has expired`.
Alex: Both: expired intermediate + some clients strict OCSP checks. That would explain mixed 525 and 502s depending on client implementation.
Priya: Impact: 100% of requests to us-west-2 edge are failing for customers that enforce strict chain verification. Rough estimate: ~8% of global traffic, lots of business-critical tenants.
incident-bot: Incident created: SEV2 - TLS chain expiry affecting prod edge (1969876543). Runbook: https://ops/redwood/runbooks/tls-chain-expiry
Alex: Mitigation plan: 1) Swap LB to fallback cert that contains new intermediate (already validated) 2) Add temporary routing to us-east for heavy customers 3) Rotate cert bundle on all edge proxies with new chain 4) Postmortem and alerting update.
Maria: I'm uploading `prod_chain_v2.pem` to lb-west-1 now. File checksum: `sha256:2a7b...d9f1`
Samir: @Maria once uploaded can you `sudo service lb reload`? I'll watch health checks.
Maria: Done upload. Running reload...
Maria: reload complete. `curl -I https://gateway.prod.redwood.ai/health --resolve gateway.prod.redwood.ai:443:34.200.10.11` returns `HTTP/2 200` now from lb-west-1.
Devon: I'm still seeing a subset of errors from the same region — perhaps some edge nodes still have the old chain. Kicking rolling restart for proxy-asg in us-west-2: `for i in $(aws ec2 describe-instances --filters ...); do ssh $i 'sudo systemctl restart edge-proxy'; done`
Alex: I'll enable routing fallback: mark us-west-2 as degraded in the router so non-strict clients can be routed via us-east.
Priya: Notifying top affected customers via CSM and support: sending an initial status message.
Samir: Health checks are green across 80% of nodes. Error rate dropped from 18% -> 3% in the last 8 minutes. Still seeing flapping for long-lived connections.
Devon: Looks like clients with pinned intermediates are still failing — they cache chain. We should advise customers to refresh, but that's not ideal.
Alex: For now, set edge-connect timeout lower and enable aggressive retry to fallback region. Patch deployed to router policy `failover-strict=true`.
incident-bot: Note: escalation to SRE lead triggered: @Priya.
Priya: I'll take lead for the incident. @Alex @Maria please continue rollout, @Devon check any long-lived TCP sockets and kill stale proxies.
Maria: Rolling cert update finished on all remaining nodes at 10:29Z.
Devon: All long-lived TCP sockets reset on proxies. New connections show full chain with valid intermediates.
Samir: Monitoring: 1m 5xx now 0.9%, latency normalizing.
Priya: Customer impact: affected tenants mostly on older SDK versions and some enterprise customers with strict chain validation. Not a data leak. Good candidate for postmortem and customer comms.
Alex: Handoff: I'm going offline in 15 to go on-call rest. @Priya you're primary. Logging all actions in the incident doc.
Priya: Taking over. Next steps: postmortem, code fix to avoid manual intermediate bundles, automation to rotate chain across LB + proxies, add synthetic checks for intermediate validity, update alert to trigger when any cert in chain expires within 7d.
incident-bot: Incident state: Mitigated -> monitoring. Closed to active paging at 10:30Z.
Priya: Filing postmortem and scheduling a follow-up with infra + security to review key rotation flow. Thanks all. :heart:
Alex: thx everyone. :thumbsup:
